import SpecPageHeader from '@beskid/beskid-ui/platform-spec/SpecPageHeader.astro';
import SpecSection from '@beskid/beskid-ui/platform-spec/SpecSection.astro';
import DomainTiles from '@beskid/beskid-ui/platform-spec/DomainTiles.astro';

<SpecPageHeader ownerName="Piotr Mikstacki" ownerEmail="pmikstacki@cybernomad.it" submitterName="Piotr Mikstacki" submitterEmail="pmikstacki@cybernomad.it" />
<SpecSection title="Scope" id="scope">
Language Server Protocol contracts for IntelliSense, diagnostics behavior, and workspace analysis integration.
</SpecSection>

<SpecSection title="Feature index" id="feature-index">
Use the tiles below for normative **feature** contracts in this area.
</SpecSection>

<SpecSection title="Meta / compiler mods" id="meta-lsp">
When the workspace includes **`Mod` projects**, the language server **must** use the same `CompilationContext` and meta invalidation rules as the CLI (**[Diagnostics and workspace analysis](/platform-spec/tooling/lsp/diagnostics-and-workspace-analysis/)**, **[Snapshot and refresh contract](/platform-spec/tooling/lsp/snapshot-and-refresh-contract/)**). Status phases **should** reuse the `beskid_pipeline` vocabulary surfaced through CLI observers so extension UX can show meta progress consistently.
</SpecSection>

<DomainTiles pathPrefix="platform-spec/tooling/lsp" heading="Features" />
